title: Treat zero decimal places as an explicit formatting setting
answers: Why does Decimal places set to 0 still show fractions in a SQL Big number?
How should table formatting distinguish zero decimal places from an unset value?
Should Short style honor a retained decimal places setting?
body:
Symptom: A SQL insight Big number or table cell displays fractions under style None even when Decimal places is 0.
Root cause: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:formatDataWithSettings and dataVisualizationLogic (tabularData selector) used truthiness checks that skipped zero.
Fix pattern: Check decimalPlaces != null before applying configured rounding; the table selector must bypass this rounding under Short style.
Constraints: Zero is a valid setting. Unset decimal places must preserve full precision in formatDataWithSettings; Short style ignores retained decimal places and uses its own formatting.
applies: SQL insight numeric display formatting in Big numbers and table cells.
